description: This file defines the Vtiger_Menu class, which provides an API for managing menu instances within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for initializing menus, adding/removing modules to/from menus, retrieving menu instances, and synchronizing menu data with filesystem components.

classes.name: Vtiger_Menu
classes.description: Provides API to work with vtiger CRM Menu, including managing menu items and modules attached to them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a new Vtiger_Menu object.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the menu instance with provided data map.

methods.name: __getNextRelSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for menu relation ordering.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Associates a module with this menu instance.

methods.name: removeModule
methods.description: Removes a module from this menu instance.

methods.name: detachModule
methods.description: Detaches a module from all menus.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Fetches a menu instance from the database by label or ID.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages related to menu operations.

methods.name: syncfile
methods.description: Synchronizes menu data to associated flat files.
